[[Image:Shortbreadrounds.jpg|thumb|Shortbread rounds before being baked|308x308px]]

'''Shortbread''' is a type of [[Cookbook:Cookie|cookie]] which is traditionally made from one part [[Cookbook:Sugar|white sugar]], two parts [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]], and three parts [[Cookbook:Flour|plain white flour]], although other ingredients like [[Cookbook:Rice flour|ground rice]] or [[Cookbook:Cornstarch|cornstarch]] are sometimes added to alter the texture.  Shortbread is so named because of its crumbly texture (from an old meaning of the word short).  The cause of this texture is its high [[Cookbook:Fat|fat]] content, provided by the butter.  The related word "[[Cookbook:Shortening|shortening]]" refers to any fat that may be added to produce a short (crumbly) texture.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.etymonline.com/index.php?term=shortening|accessdate=2007-01-25|title=Online Etymology Dictionary}}</ref>

==Ingredients==
* 380 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] (1 ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] / 13 ½ [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) [[Cookbook:All-purpose flour|all-purpose flour]]
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 220 g (1 cup / 8 oz) [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* 110 g (½ cup / 4 oz) white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]

==Equipment==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Sieve|sieve]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Mixing Bowl|mixing bowl]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Rolling Pin|rolling pin]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Wooden Spoon|wooden spoon]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Fork|table fork]] (optional, leave out for Iced Shortbread)
* 1 scone cutter or circular [[Cookbook:Cookie Cutter|cookie cutter]] (optional)
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cooling rack|cooling rack]]

==Procedure==
#Preheat the [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to [[Cookbook:Oven temperatures|140°C (275°F or Gas Mark 1)]].
#[[Cookbook:Creaming|Cream]] the butter with the sugar until light and fluffy.
#[[Cookbook:Sifting|Sift]] the flour and salt into the mixture and work into the fat and sugar until completely amalgamated.
#Shape the dough into a ball and [[Cookbook:Dough#Rolling|roll out]] to about 1.3 [[Cookbook:Centimetre|cm]] (½ [[Cookbook:Inch|inch]]) thick. The dough may need to be chilled for 10–15 minutes for easier handling.
#Cut into squares or rectangles and prick the tops with a fork in two parallel lines.
#[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] in the oven for 30–40 minutes or until the shortbread is lightly browned.
#Leave them on a cooling rack to cool.
#Store in a cool place in an airtight container.

== Notes & Variations ==

* Some recipes call for a 1-2-3 ratio of sugar, fat, and flour, but fat is often increased to prevent dryness.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Kathrin |date=2022-11-10 |title=Schnelle 3-Zutaten-Kekse |url=https://www.backenmachtgluecklich.de/rezepte/einfache-kekse-aus-3-zutaten.html |access-date=2025-04-27 |website=Backen macht glücklich |language=de-DE}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Myacooks |title=Real English Shortbread or 123 Shortbread Recipe - Food.com |url=https://www.food.com/recipe/real-english-shortbread-or-123-shortbread-442664 |access-date=2025-04-27 |website=www.food.com |language=en}}</ref>
